summary: A harness-prompt card's attention presentation carries its prompt: the tool calls without a result in the seat's conversation, the answers st offers and whether a client may answer

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. presentation.prompt is already in the client contract.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The attention refresher now serves presentation.prompt on harness-prompt cards: up to five calls without a result, each input cut at 4 KiB, the offered answers and allow; or calls null with unknown_reason when st cannot read the seat's conversation on this node. Older clients ignore it.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Each prompt card reads the newest 256 entries of its seat's conversation when the attention list folds, through the conversation cache client reads share.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions; an older daemon serves no prompt and clients fall back to reading the conversation themselves.
